editor.label: Editor
editor.subtitle: The desktop editor. Changes apply to open files at once.

files.label: Files and search
files.subtitle: What Files, Quick Open and Search leave out, and how Search and the Search Editor behave.

terminal.label: Terminal
terminal.subtitle: The integrated terminal. Changes apply to open terminals at once.

sourceControl.label: Source control
sourceControl.subtitle: Applies to every project on this machine.

fileIconTheme.label: File icons
fileIconTheme.description: Material gives each file type and well-known folder its own colored icon, with variants for the light theme. Minimal uses a few monochrome icons in the theme's colors.

restoreLayout.label: Reopen where I left off
restoreLayout.description: Remembers the open project and chat, the sidebar sections and their sizes, and the pane layout.

restoreDefaultLayout.label: Restore default layout
restoreDefaultLayout.description: Puts every pane, section and size back to how Damocles first opened.

language.label: Language
language.description: Interface language. Applies after a restart.

notify.label: Notify me when a chat needs me
notify.description: Pop-ups show on the desktop when a chat needs you, whether or not the Damocles window is focused. Off, notifications still collect under the bell.

notifySound.label: Play a sound with desktop pop-ups
notifySound.description: A short chime when a pop-up appears: rising when a chat waits on you, a single note when one finishes, falling when one stops.

updateCheckAutomatically.label: Check for updates automatically
updateCheckAutomatically.description: Checks GitHub for a new release at startup, every 4 hours and after the computer wakes. When off, Damocles contacts GitHub only when you choose Check for updates.

whatsNew.label: What's new
whatsNew.description: Release notes for every version, newest first.

editorFontSize.label: Font size
editorFontSize.description: Text size in the editor, in pixels.

editorTabSize.label: Tab size
editorTabSize.description: Spaces per indentation step when a file does not say.

editorDetectIndentation.label: Detect indentation
editorDetectIndentation.description: Takes the tab size and tabs or spaces from each file's content.

editorWordWrap.label: Word wrap
editorWordWrap.description: Wrap long lines at the editor's width.

editorMinimap.label: Minimap
editorMinimap.description: A small overview of the file beside the text.

editorRenderWhitespace.label: Render whitespace
editorRenderWhitespace.description: When spaces and tabs show as dots and arrows.

editorAutoSave.label: Auto save
editorAutoSave.description: After delay saves one second after your last edit. On focus change saves when the editor loses focus.

editorFormatOnSave.label: Format on save
editorFormatOnSave.description: Formats on save and on auto save at focus change, with the trusted project's own Prettier 2 or 3, else the built-in formatter for TypeScript, JavaScript and JSON. Never in an untrusted folder or on auto save after delay.

filesExclude.label: Files exclude
filesExclude.description: Glob patterns of files and folders the Files section hides. Quick Open skips them too.

terminalDefaultProfile.label: Default profile
terminalDefaultProfile.description: The shell a new terminal starts when you do not pick one.

terminalProfiles.label: Profiles
terminalProfiles.description: Shells you add in your user settings file, each with a path, arguments, an icon and a color. Set a detected shell to null to hide it. Project and local settings files cannot add or change a profile.

terminalFontSize.label: Font size
terminalFontSize.description: Text size in the terminal, in pixels.

terminalScrollback.label: Scrollback
terminalScrollback.description: Lines each terminal keeps above the screen.

terminalCursorStyle.label: Cursor style
terminalCursorStyle.description: How the terminal draws its cursor.

exclude.label: Search exclude
exclude.description: Glob patterns of files and folders Search and Quick Open skip, on top of the Files exclude patterns. The Search toggle Use Exclude Settings and Ignore Files turns them off for one search.

mode.label: Search mode
mode.description: Controls where new Find in Files and Find in Folder operations occur: either in the Search view, or in a search editor.

sortOrder.label: Sort order
sortOrder.description: Controls sorting order of search results.

collapseResults.label: Collapse results
collapseResults.description: Controls whether the search results will be collapsed or expanded.

defaultViewMode.label: Default view mode
defaultViewMode.description: Controls the default search result view mode.

actionsPosition.label: Actions position
actionsPosition.description: Controls the positioning of the actionbar on rows in the Search view.

smartCase.label: Smart case
smartCase.description: Search case-insensitively if the pattern is all lowercase, otherwise, search case-sensitively.

searchOnType.label: Search on type
searchOnType.description: Search all files as you type.

showLineNumbers.label: Show line numbers
showLineNumbers.description: Controls whether to show line numbers for search results.

seedOnFocus.label: Seed on focus
seedOnFocus.description: Update the search query to the editor's selected text when focusing the Search view.

seedWithNearestWord.label: Seed with nearest word
seedWithNearestWord.description: Enable seeding search from the word nearest the cursor when the active editor has no selection.

useReplacePreview.label: Use replace preview
useReplacePreview.description: Controls whether to open Replace Preview when selecting or replacing a match.

searchOnTypeDebouncePeriod.label: Search on type debounce period
searchOnTypeDebouncePeriod.description: When Search on type is on, the time in milliseconds between a character being typed and the search starting.

maxResults.label: Max results
maxResults.description: Controls the maximum number of search results, at most 20,000.

doubleClickBehaviour.label: Double-click behaviour
doubleClickBehaviour.description: Configure effect of double-clicking a result in a search editor.

defaultNumberOfContextLines.label: Default number of context lines
defaultNumberOfContextLines.description: The default number of surrounding context lines to use when creating new Search Editors.

reusePriorSearchConfiguration.label: Reuse prior search configuration
reusePriorSearchConfiguration.description: When enabled, new Search Editors will reuse the includes, excludes, and flags of the previously opened Search Editor.

focusResultsOnSearch.label: Focus results on search
focusResultsOnSearch.description: When a search is triggered, focus the Search Editor results instead of the Search Editor input.

terminalFontFamily.label: Font family
terminalFontFamily.description: A CSS font-family list for the terminal. Empty uses the app's monospace font.

terminalLineHeight.label: Line height
terminalLineHeight.description: The height of each terminal line, as a multiple of the font size.

terminalCursorBlinking.label: Cursor blinking
terminalCursorBlinking.description: Whether the terminal cursor blinks while the terminal has focus.

terminalMultiLinePasteWarning.label: Multi-line paste warning
terminalMultiLinePasteWarning.description: When to ask before pasting several lines. Auto asks unless the shell turned on bracketed paste mode or the only line break is the last character.

terminalShellIntegrationEnabled.label: Shell integration
terminalShellIntegrationEnabled.description: Start PowerShell, bash, Git Bash, zsh and fish with a script that reports each command, its exit code and the working directory. Command marks, command titles, links relative to the working directory and the kill confirmation use it. Applies to new terminals.

terminalShellIntegrationDecorationsEnabl.label: Command marks
terminalShellIntegrationDecorationsEnabl.description: Show a mark beside each command with its exit code while shell integration is active.

terminalConfirmOnKill.label: Confirm before kill
terminalConfirmOnKill.description: When to ask before killing terminals, closing the window, removing a project or quitting. Running asks when a command runs in a terminal.

terminalMacOptionIsMeta.label: Option is Meta
terminalMacOptionIsMeta.description: The Option key sends Meta (Esc) sequences, as terminal programs such as Emacs expect, instead of typing special characters.

gitUntrackedChanges.label: Untracked changes
gitUntrackedChanges.description: Separate shows untracked files in their own group. Hidden leaves them out.

gitRepositoryScanMaxDepth.label: Repository scan depth
gitRepositoryScanMaxDepth.description: How many folders below the project folder to look for nested repositories. -1 looks at every level.

gitOpenRepositoryInParentFolders.label: Open repositories in parent folders
gitOpenRepositoryInParentFolders.description: Whether a repository that holds the project folder from above opens: always, never, or after asking.

gitInputValidation.label: Commit message length warning
gitInputValidation.description: Warn while the commit message line you are on runs past the limits below.

gitInputValidationSubjectLength.label: Subject length limit
gitInputValidationSubjectLength.description: Characters in the first line of a commit message before the warning shows.

gitInputValidationLength.label: Line length limit
gitInputValidationLength.description: Characters in the other lines of a commit message before the warning shows.

gitBranchProtection.label: Protected branches
gitBranchProtection.description: Committing on one of these asks first. Separate names with commas.

gitBranchProtectionPrompt.label: Protected branch prompt
gitBranchProtectionPrompt.description: What Commit does on a protected branch.

gitPromptToSaveFilesBeforeCommit.label: Save files before commit
gitPromptToSaveFilesBeforeCommit.description: Ask to save unsaved editors of changed files before committing. Staged asks only about files with staged changes.

gitAlwaysSignOff.label: Always sign off
gitAlwaysSignOff.description: Add a Signed-off-by trailer to every commit.

gitEnableCommitSigning.label: Sign commits
gitEnableCommitSigning.description: Sign every commit with your GPG or SSH key (-S).

gitAllowNoVerifyCommit.label: Allow no-verify commits
gitAllowNoVerifyCommit.description: Shows the No Verify commit variants, which skip pre-commit hooks.

gitConfirmEmptyCommits.label: Confirm empty commits
gitConfirmEmptyCommits.description: Ask before Commit Empty creates a commit with no changes.

gitEnableSmartCommit.label: Smart commit
gitEnableSmartCommit.description: With nothing staged, Commit stages every change and commits it without asking.

gitSuggestSmartCommit.label: Suggest smart commit
gitSuggestSmartCommit.description: With nothing staged, Commit offers to stage every change first.

gitSmartCommitChanges.label: Smart commit changes
gitSmartCommitChanges.description: Which changes smart commit stages: all of them, or only tracked files.

gitBranchPrefix.label: Branch prefix
gitBranchPrefix.description: Prefills the name of a new branch, as in Commit to a New Branch. Worktree chats use damocles/ when this is empty.

gitAutofetch.label: Autofetch
gitAutofetch.description: Fetch from the remotes of the open project in the background. A failure is logged, never prompted.

gitPruneOnFetch.label: Prune on fetch
gitPruneOnFetch.description: Remove remote-tracking branches that no longer exist on the remote.

gitConfirmSync.label: Confirm sync
gitConfirmSync.description: Ask before Sync pulls and pushes.

gitRebaseWhenSync.label: Rebase when syncing
gitRebaseWhenSync.description: Sync runs a rebase instead of a merge when it pulls.

gitFollowTagsWhenSync.label: Follow tags when syncing
gitFollowTagsWhenSync.description: Push annotated tags that point at pushed commits.

gitAllowForcePush.label: Allow force push
gitAllowForcePush.description: Shows the force variants of Push. Each one still asks first.

gitAutoStash.label: Auto stash
gitAutoStash.description: Stash local changes before a pull and restore them after it.

gitDefaultCloneDirectory.label: Default clone folder
gitDefaultCloneDirectory.description: Where Clone puts new repositories. Empty asks for a folder each time.

gitOpenAfterClone.label: Open after clone
gitOpenAfterClone.description: Add the cloned repository as a project: always, or after asking.

gitPullBeforeCheckout.label: Pull before checkout
gitPullBeforeCheckout.description: Fast-forward a branch that has no outgoing commits before checking it out.

gitPromptToSaveFilesBeforeStash.label: Save files before stash
gitPromptToSaveFilesBeforeStash.description: Ask to save unsaved editors of changed files before stashing. Staged asks only about files with staged changes.

alwaysShowHeaderActions.label: Always show section actions
alwaysShowHeaderActions.description: Controls the visibility of sidebar section actions. Section actions may either be always visible, or only visible when that section is focused or hovered over.

gitBlameEditorDecorationEnabled.label: Inline blame
gitBlameEditorDecorationEnabled.description: Show who last changed the cursor's line, at the line's end.
